i.norm: Verifies that the Match Rating Approach (MRA) encoder correctly identifies "Karl" and "Alessandro" as phonetically dissimilar names. Despite both starting with vowel-adjacent consonants, their encoded forms differ significantly in length (KRL vs ALSNDR), causing the algorithm to reject a match before even reaching the rating comparison step.

"Karl" encodes to a short consonant skeleton (KRL) while "Alessandro" encodes to a much longer one (ALSNDR). The MRA algorithm rejects pairs whose encoded forms differ in length by 3 or more characters, so these two names must NOT be considered a match.
